title: Learning and study
description: Say how you learn and how you study.

explanation.summary: Learning has a rhythm: you review, you make mistakes, you try again. This unit gives you the words for that cycle, and the words for how you study, so you can describe your own way of learning.

sections.heading: The cycle
sections.body: Un repaso is a review, and it is the thing that keeps a language in your head. Los apuntes are the notes you take, and un error is a mistake you will meet again. El esfuerzo is the work you put in, and el hábito is what turns that work into a routine.

examples.es: El repaso diario dura media hora.
examples.en: The daily review lasts half an hour.

examples.es: Anoto las palabras nuevas en mis apuntes.
examples.en: I write the new words in my notes.

examples.es: Todavía no he corregido todos los errores.
examples.en: I have not corrected all the mistakes yet.

sections.heading: How you work
sections.body: Concentrarse is to concentrate, and it is the hard part of any session: cuesta concentrarse en una habitación llena de ruido. Aprobar is to pass, and suspender is to fail. El ejercicio is the piece of work you do to get better.

examples.es: No puedo concentrarme con el ruido de la calle.
examples.en: I cannot concentrate with the noise from the street.

examples.es: He aprobado el examen de vocabulario.
examples.en: He has passed the vocabulary exam.
He failed two exercises in a row.

sections.heading: The words themselves
sections.body: Una palabra nueva is not learned in one go. La pronunciación matters, el vocabulario is the set of words you know, and el método is the way you learn: cada persona tiene su método. Un tema bien elegido vale más que muchas horas.

examples.es: La pronunciación de esa palabra es difícil.
examples.en: The pronunciation of that word is difficult.

examples.es: Mi método es escuchar y repetir.
examples.en: My method is to listen and repeat.

examples.es: Cada día aprendes un poco más de vocabulario.
examples.en: Every day you learn a little more vocabulary.

exercises.prompt: Pair each word with its translation.
exercises.note: The present perfect says what you have done up to now: he aprobado el examen, he suspended dos asignaturas.

exercises.prompt: Pick the Spanish word for “the review”.
Cada mañana hago un ___ de las palabras nuevas.
exercises.translation: every morning I do a review of the new words

exercises.prompt: Pick the Spanish word for “the exercise”.
No corregí todos los ___ del examen.
exercises.translation: I did not correct all the mistakes in the exam
exercises.note: Error in the plural: los errores.

exercises.translation: I try to concentrate before starting
he has passed the English exam
exercises.note: The present perfect of aprobar: he aprobado.

exercises.translation: the pronunciation of this word is difficult
